Git , and writing clean, readable code. AI-first working: daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples of how it helped you deliver faster. Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus. Strong plus Redis, and background job queues (Celery, RQ, ARQ, RabbitMQ or similar). WebSockets and async Python (asyncio). Multi-tenant SaaS: customer-level data separation, roles and permissions. Windows desktop or tray apps, and packaging Python apps (PyInstaller, Nuitka, Inno Setup, MSI). Payment gateway integration (Razorpay), email and SMS services, Google sign-in (OAuth). Vite, React Query, Tailwind CSS or similar modern frontend tools. Node.js or another backend language.
